description: Nook's own windows (the panel, the bar, the popover, the agent dock nook_dock, the quick-ask box nook_ask and later the palette): they may listen for nook://state, nook://chrome and nook://ask and nothing more. Their one command, nook_ui (ask_pip for the quick-ask box), checks the window's label and that its page is Hearth's own.
